title: Tag input
summary: Free-text entries collected as tags: allergies, diagnosis codes, email recipients. When the options are known in advance, use a MultiCombobox instead.

demos.title: Default
demos.note: Each entry becomes a tag with its own remove button. The same entry cannot be added twice: try Latex again.

c.name: Press Enter or a comma to add. Backspace
c.text: Press Enter or a comma to add. Backspace removes the last one.

demos.title: Validation
demos.note: validate returns a message to reject an entry, or null to accept it. Try typing 'cholesterol'.
